author: NewVoltdrive
body:
Don't get me wrong, Avicore is great, but there were somethings that seemed off, or somethings that needed to be added, or didn't need to be removed.
-Removing the punch-sign to teleport to game
I realize that there is a quick teleport, but I'm just not a big fan of that. Punching the sign was a lot more impressive. Even if you were going to remove it, I wish there was a game selector.
-Converting CTW maps to DTM
This is mainly geared toward Rendezvous 2. That map was built for a quick entrance, quick exit, get back to your side. Sorry, but I don't think the way it is now works.
-No new Avicade games
Now, I only spent like 15 minutes with Avicade, so I might look like an idiot, but I didn't notice any new Avicade games. *sigh*
-The forums
Did we really need a forum overhaul? The old forum worked just fine. I realize that this looks a lot like OCN, but that isn't really much of a problem, we use the same system for websites. I will admit, however, the profiles are awesome.
-Lack of new CTH maps.
I know this isn't fully your fault, but there is only 1 new map here, plus Forerunner was re-added. That's it. When I fly back home, I will re-post my maps to help with this.
-Removal of Owner rank
This may seem like a small problem, but this just makes Howsie and Gill look like they own the server. Especially Howsie.
Now, I only got to spend an hour with Avicore, so some of these may already be fixed/not a problem, but these are things I noticed.

replies.author: _Gill
replies.body:
There will be a quick teleport item in the inventory. I don't believe that was meant to be removed.
We only had one CTW map, so we decided to change it to our most profound mini game, DTM.
Avicade games will be made in the future. We wanted to get this update out as quickly as possible.
The only real similarity between out forums and OCNs forums is the sidebar. Basically everything else is more unique and more appealing. There are much less similarities (white background, the selection bar, etc). 
If you go to Funky's profile page, he still does have the owner rank... Don't really know where you were going with that
There haven't been many acceptable CTH map submissions, so I am sorry about that. We will be making more in the future.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: The look and feel of the server is better - but the kits are really lacking.   The Poseidon kit (lvl 15) is the strongest kit, and if more than one person on a team gets it the match is over.  I just spent 25 min in a match where 3 of us had Poseidon and different teams and we could not kill each other - after getting board I gave up. As more and more people pick that kit it will be the only kit played and the game will be ruined.Barbarian is a joke - 3-4 sec strength after a kill? really weak. - It was one of the best kits. I am glad to see some of the older kits fixed, but my goodness the walls is pretty much over. Also, kits that give regen on a kill or start you out with a potion of regen.... not really good kits - I like the dwarf kit, but 90% are just not applicable to making the matches better and in most cases selecting any kit other than a few of the best ones, will put you at a huge disadvantage.OP Kits - Poseidon ( way over powered) - you cant drown, wont take poison damage, fire bow will not harm you, etc... two people can attack you at the same time and you will live. Currently the only way to beat a Poseidon is 1. Catch out of water with no water bucket ( they all have buckets) 2. Have strength potion and knockback to knock them out of water. 3. Have knockback and Multiple Harm potions to quick damage and knock them out of water. 4. Fall damage if your in a skybase and they climb up. Most of the time they bring full diamond or enchanted iron and multiple water buckets to the fight - no other kit comes close...Good Kits - Archer , Magician, Dwarf, ScoutEverything else is  - use at your own risk..... your just going to die fast.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Well, let me explain this again haha.
Rendezvous 2 was originally a CTW map, however, Avicus doesn't support CTW, and the community did actually like Rendezvous 2.
What did I do? I contacted ParaPenguin and asked him for permission to change Rendezvous 2 from CTW to DTM in order to bring it back.
Trust me, if CTW was still working, Divines and Rendezvous 2 would have stayed as CTW.
Also, there are actually two new maps for Control the Hill, and they are Polarix and Fairy Hills, more maps are also in the process of being made :)
Avicade will be having Sumo and Icarus (if they work properly of course...) soon, and if Snake gets fixed it will get back (Snake also had two new maps I believe).
About the forums... I won't say they are bad, but the orange numbers and the removal of the handful search bar annoys me :(. However, many profile updates did take place and I believe the forums will get better with time :)
